scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false) not the author's working copy. Backend is Go (Gin); full interface/data-access detection for Go is out of scope for skill version 1.0, so routes, auth wiring, SQL and config were read manually from internal/api/server.go, internal/middleware, internal/config, internal/auth, internal/store and docker files; coverage is best-effort. A go dependency block is added under dependencies as an extra key (same shape as python/node). Routes with auth_detected true carry no severity (N/A per severity calibration) and are not counted. Excluded/not recorded: web/src-react-backup (legacy React copy, no secrets found), web/package-lock.json. Many /api/v1 handlers in internal/api/stubs.go are unimplemented stubs returning placeholder responses. Two ELF binaries (choreme 21 MB, migrate 11 MB) are tracked in git at the repo root. .github/workflows use secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (properly referenced, not hardcoded).

gitignore_gaps: compiled binaries 'choreme' and 'migrate' at repo root are not ignored and are tracked (.gitignore only lists /bin/, *.exe)
node_modules is ignored only via web/.gitignore (root .gitignore does not list it)

interfaces.network_binding: default HOST=localhost (config.go); Dockerfile sets HOST=0.0.0.0 and exposes 8080; docker-compose publishes 8080/8081/8082; GIN_MODE defaults to debug outside Docker (Docker sets release)

databases.credential_source: env_var (DB_PASS) with placeholder values in docker-compose.yml; sqlite needs none

sql_injection_risk.reason: store layer in internal/store/*/ uses database/sql with bound parameters; no string-built SQL found in a manual review (full Go SQL analysis is out of scope for v1.0)

external_apis.host: SMTP server from SMTP_HOST (example smtp.gmail.com in .env.example)

file_system_access.detail: SQLite database file at DB_NAME (/data/choreme.db in Docker volume choreme_data)

sensitive_data_indicators.field_or_variable: email, password (bcrypt hash), role, household membership
financial balances, transfers, spending limits (child savings accounts)

docker_findings: Dockerfile final stage runs as root (no USER instruction; WORKDIR /root)
final image alpine:latest unpinned; builder golang:1.22-alpine
CMD runs './migrate up && ./main' at container start
docker-compose.yml contains placeholder JWT/DB/MySQL passwords and publishes 8080, 8081, 8082; also defines postgres:17-alpine, mysql:9.1 and caddy:2.8.4-alpine services

what_this_app_can_do: Lets anyone who can reach the server register a new household and its first user, and log in to receive a 24-hour JWT.
Lets authenticated family members view and update their own profile, and (admin/manager roles) list household users and generate invites.

Manages family savings accounts: deposits, withdrawals, transfer requests with approval, spending limits and interest rates, with role checks in handlers; a scheduler accrues interest and resets limits.
Chore, assignment, reward, redemption, ledger, audit and report endpoints exist but are largely stubs returning placeholder responses.

data_sources_touched.source: Application database (SQLite file, PostgreSQL or MySQL) holding users, households, balances and transfers
SMTP server (configured, not yet clearly used by code)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: HTTP server; binds to localhost by default but the Docker image binds 0.0.0.0:8080 and compose publishes ports. Registration, login and household join are unauthenticated; all other /api/v1 routes require a JWT. CORS allows any origin.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: JWT signing secret falls back to the hardcoded default 'your-secret-key' when JWT_SECRET is unset (Dockerfile does not set it); anyone who knows the default could forge tokens with any role
docker-compose.yml ships placeholder JWT secret and weak DB passwords
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Allow-Credentials: true on all responses
Financial-style data (balances, transfers) of minors stored; no rate limiting seen on login

top_findings: JWT secret defaults to a hardcoded value in internal/config/config.go if JWT_SECRET is unset (high)
Wildcard CORS with credentials; Docker image binds 0.0.0.0 and runs as root
Placeholder credentials in docker-compose.yml (low); compiled binaries tracked in git
